messages.author: 160e07de5a273fcd
messages.subject: moderated mediation using LMS
parts:
Hi all,

I am attempting to run a moderated mediation using the LMS method (i.e., latent moderated structural equation modeling). I have created my product indicators and my latent variables. I am wondering if I need to specify a pathway for the moderator to get a specific parameter to interpret the moderator in my output? I've attached a part of my syntax below. Any help is appreciated! Thank you!

#reappraisal model
MOD1 <- '
ParentingBehaviors=~ ZOverT5+ZLaxT5+ZHosT5
ZOverT5~~ZLaxT5
ZOverT5~~ZHosT5
ZLaxT5~~ZHosT5
FIS=~ PS8i + PS8j + PS7f
CIS=~ PS8a + PS8b + PS8c + PS8d + PS8e + PS8e + PS8f + PS3
CIS~~FIS
MatStress=~ ZlogPSS_P2 + ZPSS_P1 + ZPSS_P3

#moderators
FISxreappraisal=~ prod4+prod5+prod6+prod7+prod8+prod9+prod10
CISxreappraisal=~ prod14+prod15+prod16+prod17+prod18+prod19+prod20

#direct effect, predictor to outcome
ParentingBehaviors ~ c*FIS + b*MatStress + d*CIS + ChildSex + INR + MomRace

#predictor to mediator
MatStress ~ a*FIS + e*CIS + ZERQR + FISxreappraisal + CISxreappraisal + ChildSex + INR + MomRace

#indirect effect for FIS to MatStress
ab := a*b

#indirect effect for CIS to MatStress
eb := e*b

'

Best,

Jordan

messages.author: bc810b1d0900407f
messages.subject: Re: moderated mediation using LMS
parts:
This paper is a good one on doing latent variable moderation in lavaan using semTools:

Schoemann, A. M., & Jorgensen, T. D. (2021). Testing and Interpreting Latent Variable Interactions Using the semTools Package. Psych, 3(3), Article 3. https://doi.org/10.3390/psych3030024

Another option is the factor score approach.

Ng, J. C. K., & Chan, W. (2020). Latent moderation analysis: A factor score approach. Structural Equation Modeling: A Multidisciplinary Journal, 27(4), 629–648. https://doi.org/10.1080/10705511.2019.1664304

Although they did not cover moderated mediation, I believe mediators can be included in their methods.

Regards,
Shu Fai Cheung (張樹輝)

Although they did not cover moderated mediation, I believe mediators can be included in their methods.

Regards,
